title: Windows Server October Updates Break Exchange Sign-Ins
excerpt: Microsoft reports that recent Windows Server security updates are disrupting mail delivery and OWA sign-ins on certain Exchange Server systems.
body_html:
Microsoft has confirmed that the security updates released for Windows Server this month are causing technical problems for certain Exchange Server systems. According to the company, the updates lead to issues with Outlook on the Web (OWA) sign-in processes as well as disruptions in mail delivery.

Administrators managing affected environments may experience difficulties with user authentication and email flow following the installation of the October patches. Microsoft has acknowledged the situation, though specific mitigation steps or permanent fixes are typically detailed through their official support channels as investigations continue.
